name: Causeway Bay Guest Accommodation
accommodation: Modern, newly decorated B&B rooms (number not stated)
suitableFor: Couples and small groups wanting a central B&B
overview: A refurbished B&B in central Portrush that overlooks West Strand, directly opposite the railway station and Curry's Amusements. Rooms are modern and newly decorated, with free WiFi and a cooked buffet-style breakfast. The harbour is about five minutes' walk away, and the Giant's Causeway and Carrick-a-Rede are within easy reach by car.
surfTripFit: Looking straight over West Strand and next to the station, it suits surfers arriving by train who want to walk to the water.
